title: dioscorea aristolochiifolia var. parvifolia
intro: Dioscorea aristolochiifolia var. parvifolia, commonly known as a type of yam, is a plant species belonging to the family Dioscoreaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Dioscorea aristolochiifolia var. parvifolia include anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-ulcerative activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as diosgenin, saponins, and flavonoids. These constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's therapeutic actions, supporting its traditional use in folk medicine for various health conditions.
